## Checklist

- [ ] The unit tests pass (`python -m unittest discover -s tests/unit`).
- [ ] New behaviour has tests, and a fixed defect has a test that fails without the fix.
- [ ] The documentation in `docs/` is updated when a parameter, an input format or an output changes.
- [ ] The change contains no data that I am not allowed to publish, and no results or generated files.
- [ ] Commit messages follow the conventional commits style.
